title: Relay
subtitle: A computer, exposed.
description: A complete eight-bit computer workbench: write and assemble real 16-bit instruction words, follow live data transfers, debug with breakpoints and reverse execution, and turn 32 bytes of video RAM into a 16-by-16 display.
instruction: Step to fetch the first instruction. Edit the source, assemble your changes, and follow real registers, memory, and pixels. Run is always opt-in.
